refactor(watchers): watch_file sources hold their watches through the registry, which shares one handle per directory (brandon-unfiled-3248.pijr) (#498)

* refactor(watchers): watch_file sources hold their watches through the registry, which shares one handle per directory (brandon-unfiled-3248.pijr)

The var-system's own watch manager opened, filtered, failed and closed its
fs.watch handles beside the watcher registry, so its handles never reached
the daemon's counters or log. It is gone: a watch_file path follows its
spec through the registry's `follow`, as the config and git watches do.

The registry gains what that needed, as rules for every consumer:
- one OS handle per directory, refcounted by the slots on it, and `follow`
  acquires before it releases, so a key move (a link re-pointed to a new
  name) keeps every directory both keys name open;
- a directory made again at its path is reopened in place when a slot
  acquires it; a deaf one is reopened only through `listening`, which only
  watch_file calls, at a real event on a kept watch, never on a failed one;
- every holder of a key hears each window; a directory going deaf is told
  to every slot on it; the handle's `deaf` list is live;
- a directory's own name under a name filter is judged by the folder at the
  path, not the event type; an unnamed event under a filter is `unknown`;
- daemon-stats counts directory handles opened, closed and open beside the
  slots, and the registry logs every open, close and reopen with its cause.

* fix(watchers): a directory watch follows the folder at its path, and every slot on it hears it recover (brandon-unfiled-3248.pijr)

Review of #498:
- An event naming a directory whose folder was made again moves the handle
  onto the new folder, so later own-name events (macOS: a child came or went)
  no longer pass every name filter.
- A reopen that listens tells every slot an unknown window, so a shared
  directory's other holders re-read what went unheard and clear their fault.
- Joining a slot refreshes its directories as opening one does, so a rebind
  onto a key another holder owns retries its deaf directory.
- Managed storage judges an unknown window against the disk: it may hold the
  folder's own event.
- watch_file's follow-then-retry is one step, the window's cause its input.

* fix(watchers): a directory's state is its current handle's to change (brandon-unfiled-3248.pijr)

Review of #498 (medium):
- An error or event from a handle a reopen replaced no longer marks the
  directory deaf or fires its slots; the bound folder is read from the
  current state, not a closure copy.
- One predicate says whether a path binds a folder, for the watch key and
  the refresh.
- The follow comment says where a deaf directory is retried; the memory
  lines say the handle follows a folder made again, and why storage still
  recovers through a reload.

* fix(watchers): a retry reopens deaf directories and judges no folder's identity (brandon-unfiled-3248.pijr)

Review of #498 (second high):
- listening retries deaf directories only. Judging identity there gave the
  reopen's unknown window a path back to another reopen wherever a folder's
  identity is unstable; a moved folder is the next derive's new key, which
  acquires and refreshes.
- The config and git bind log lines say deaf=, which counts directories
  that failed after opening as well as those refused.

* test(git-cache): a looped git directory's open count is the platform's, as its deaf count is (brandon-unfiled-3248.pijr)

Linux's recursive watcher swallows the symlink loop under refs/heads and
opens it; macOS refuses it. The directory watches opened are the targets
less the deaf ones, read from the bind line.
test(colour): the menu bytes draw the named activated shades over rich-js 0.25's arrows (candybar-joiners-e5r4.dg6)
test(colour): drop the DecorEntry import the deleted row-ground test left unread (candybar-joiners-e5r4.dg6)

docs(colour): the colour design doc states the open menu's named shades, not the search they replaced (candybar-joiners-e5r4.dg6)

COLOUR-FROM-THEME-VOCABULARY.md is ACTIVE and is where the colour memory
sends a reader for the rationale, but its rule, region table and
disclosure rules still described the state search, the plane's
recession and the floors as current. They now state the selected
shades; a dg6 entry in Decisions says what it supersedes and points to
PROPOSAL-joiners.md for why, and "What was deleted" lists the symbols.
test(colour): the palette-identity walk names its one exemption, and why authored backgrounds need none (candybar-joiners-e5r4.dg6)

fix(colour): the activated segment and its menu plane wear named theme shades; the inter-cell floors go (candybar-joiners-e5r4.dg6)

The segment whose menu is open, the ✕ and blank leads of that menu's rows,
and the plane the rows sit on now select colours the theme names, the way
every closed cell already does. The activated state is the menu hue at a new
`activated` column of the shade table: the hue's muted form on every window
of the ladder, its second lightening on the `muted` position. The plane is
`surface` at every depth. Items are unchanged.

Deleted: the open-trigger colour search and its rays, the plane blend and
its floors, the band item repair at 256 and ansi, every floor stated in
STATE_FLOOR, BAND_FLOORS or SEAM_MIN_DELTA_E, the shortfalls a band carried,
and the `band-floor` render warning with its cases in check and the daemon.
A disclosure no longer carries the ground its row dealt, since nothing reads
it. Text is unchanged: it is still chosen to clear AA on whatever it is
drawn on.
fix(picker): a catalogue page laid out as one line stays closed on its segment's ground (candybar-plugins-vf6g.qzx)
fix(tmux): reset-all's memory line matches the gated reset, a refused tmux follower is told it needs a tmux pane, and a hintless click's in-tmux reading is cited (candybar-plugins-vf6g.qzx)

fix(tmux): a session outside tmux has no tmux status line to switch, reset-all and the drift mark count a control by its one gate, and a catalogue picker paints each row for the ground it is drawn on (candybar-plugins-vf6g.qzx)
feat(tmux): the tmux status line is a renderer the config menu offers inside tmux, and a handed-off statusline is one small row (candybar-plugins-vf6g.qzx)
